mapper.select: SELECT ds.id FROM duty_shift ds JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.id = ds.incident_assignment_id WHERE ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL AND ds.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ds.started_at DESC, ds.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_path ( id, duty_shift_id, account_id, status, started_at, ended_at, geometry, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{dutyShiftId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update:
WITH append_input AS ( SELECT
ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{appendedGeometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler})
NULL::geometry
AS new_geometry ) UPDATE search_path sp SET geometry = CASE WHEN append_input.new_geometry IS NULL THEN sp.geometry WHEN sp.geometry IS NULL AND GeometryType(append_input.new_geometry) = 'POINT' THEN ST_MakeLine(append_input.new_geometry, append_input.new_geometry) WHEN sp.geometry IS NULL THEN append_input.new_geometry WHEN #{pointOffset} = 1 THEN ST_MakeLine(ST_StartPoint(sp.geometry), append_input.new_geometry) ELSE ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, append_input.new_geometry) END, version = #{nextVersion}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} FROM append_input WHERE sp.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND sp.status = 'RECORDING' AND sp.version = #{expectedVersion}
